parakeet: So one of the things that used to aggravate the hell out of me when I was a Christian was the overwhelming lack of accountability, especially in the communities I was a part of. It was like somebody could do some incredibly foul shit to you, and then just go to the church, cry at the altar, and say, Ooh, Jesus has forgiven me. And then they'll come back to you and be like, Well, God has forgiven me, so now you gotta forgive me too. And the truth of the matter is, it isn't your forgiveness that they wanted. It's the opportunity to do the same bullshit again. I ain't like that.
